item.title: Jury finds that Bill Cosby sexually assaulted woman in 1972 and awards her nearly $60 million | KMZN 99.5FM 740AM Today's News Yesterday's Hits
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — A civil jury in California found Monday that Bill Cosby was liable for drugging and sexually assaulting a woman in 1972 and awarded her $59.25 million.
